consent.title: Taking part in research
consent.about: We want to understand how people think again about their answers and their confidence after a short prompt.
consent.record: We record your choices before and after the prompt, your confidence, when you lock in and submit, and what you write in Q5.
consent.names: We don't ask for your name or email. Please don't type personal details in your written answer.
consent.data: The data is copied to a Google Sheet the team can read, and may be used in a research paper. Results describe groups only, never one person.
consent.limit: The data doesn't show why anyone changed their mind, and doesn't prove anyone learned more.
consent.who: The LOGINA team runs this study. Contact: logina.edu@gmail.com.
consent.kept: The data is kept until the paper is published, and for no more than 2 years from collection. Then we delete it.
consent.choice: Taking part is your choice. The tasks work the same either way.
consent.withdraw: To withdraw, email your participant code to logina.edu@gmail.com. We will delete your rows.
consent.agree: I agree, and I'm 18 or older
consent.once: You choose once for this session.
consent.keepCode: Keep this code. It also appears on your results page.
